note: Nearest fire-insurance map to the 1890 census. The sheets are August 1893, four sheets. This file changes the 1880 town where that map differs. The East Main face of block 72 is the frontage copied door by door.

update.name: Hotel Alexander
update.notes: Built in the summer of 1871 by S. A. Hendee. In 1885 Boyington & Son kept it as the Hendee House. The August 1893 Sanborn labels the hotel Alexander. The front is still the three-story brick front from the Hotel Alexander photograph. The lot on West Main is inferred.

update.name: Excelsior Mills
update.notes: August 1893 Sanborn, sheet 2, block 81, the Dean side between Davis and Barnes. The sheet still labels this mill Excelsior. The earlier lot by the railroad was inferred. This is the block the 1893 sheet uses.

update.name: Angel Bros. Roller Mills
update.notes: The August 1893 Sanborn index and the railroad inset label Angel Bros., Bushnell Roller Mills, beside the tracks. The building stays on the railroad ground. The 1885 name of the other mill was Excelsior.
August 1893 Sanborn, sheet 3, block 59, still the National Hotel on the Hurst end of Crawford. The sheet marks the building three stories. The January 1886 sheet shows the same hotel.

add.name: Meat
add.notes: August 1893 Sanborn, sheet 2, block 72, the south side of East Main at Hurst. This is one room of the two-story brick block with an iron front that replaced the January 1886 frame row (the candy shop, the barber shops, the saloon, and the rooms beside them). The corner room carries a pediment and a finial. The nearest census year is 1890; the map itself is August 1893. The sheet labels this room as a market.

add.name: Store
add.notes: One-story frame shop labeled S. on the August 1893 Sanborn, sheet 2, block 72, just west of the brick iron-front block.

add.name: Harness
add.notes: Two-story frame harness shop on the August 1893 Sanborn, sheet 2, block 72. The 1886 brick harness room is not this building; the brick iron-front block now stands on the Hurst side of it.

add.name: Bakery
add.notes: Two-story frame bakery on the August 1893 Sanborn, sheet 2, block 72, west of the harness shop.

add.name: China & Lamps
add.notes: Frame shop on the August 1893 Sanborn, sheet 2, block 72, labeled for china, lamps, and wallpaper. Two stories on the street.

add.name: Agricultural Implements
add.notes: Two-story brick agricultural-implement store on the August 1893 Sanborn, sheet 2, block 72. A one-story frame wing behind it is not given its own walls. An open stretch of the East Main front lies on either side.

add.name: Groceries
add.use: groceries, with a vacant room and beverages
add.notes: Two-story frame building at the Barnes end of block 72 on the August 1893 Sanborn, sheet 2. The sheet divides the front into groceries, a vacant room, and beverages. The January 1886 meat market and bowling alley are not on this front.

add.name: Vanderveer & Logsdon
add.notes: August 1893 Sanborn, sheet 4, labels Vanderveer & Logsdon Electric Light Works in the same north works district as the Bushnell Pump Company. The lot is that district, not a measured downtown corner.

add.name: City Water Works
add.notes: August 1893 Sanborn, sheet 4, and the March 1906 sheet still show the city water works by the railroad in the north part of town. The footprint is the works district on those sheets.

add.name: N.E.F. Manufacturing Co.
add.notes: August 1893 Sanborn, sheet 4, a large brick plant in the southwest works ground. The sheet prints N.E.F. Manufacturing Co. The lot is that sheet's industrial block, west of Davis.

add.name: Mack & M. Pinckley
add.notes: August 1893 Sanborn, sheet 3, lumber sheds along the railroad ground labeled Mack & M. Pinckley's lumber yard. The shed follows that trackside yard, not a store lot.

add.name: Cigar Factory
add.notes: August 1893 Sanborn, sheet 2, block 72, a cigar factory on the Hurst side of the block, south of the East Main brick row. The May 1898 and March 1906 sheets still label a cigar factory here.

add.name: Dwelling
add.notes: A frame dwelling beside Ludwig Street. The August 1893 sheet 4 and the March 1906 sheet 2 show houses on this side of Ludwig. No family name is printed. The lot is the ordinary house size on that front.

add.name: Dwelling
add.notes: A frame dwelling beside Ludwig Street. The August 1893 sheet 4 and the March 1906 sheet 2 show houses on this side of Ludwig. No family name is printed. The lot is the ordinary house size on that front.

add.name: Dwelling
add.notes: A frame dwelling beside Ludwig Street. The August 1893 sheet 4 and the March 1906 sheet 2 show houses on this side of Ludwig. No family name is printed. The lot is the ordinary house size on that front.

add.name: Dwelling
add.notes: Two-story frame dwelling on lot 312, the Gridley end of the Crawford side of block 48. August 1893 Sanborn, sheet 3. The January 1886 sheet shows sheds on this lot and no dwelling. The May 1898 and March 1906 sheets still show a two-story dwelling here. No family name is printed.

add.name: Dwelling
add.notes: Frame dwelling on the Dean side of block 71, lot 210. August 1893 Sanborn, sheet 2. Lot 209, which had a dwelling in January 1886, is empty on this sheet. Still a dwelling on the 1898 and 1906 sheets. No family name is printed.

add.name: Dwelling
add.notes: One-and-a-half-story frame dwelling on the Dean front of block 71, lot 213, just north of the Presbyterian church. August 1893 Sanborn, sheet 2. The January 1886 sheet shows the church here and no house on this front. No family name is printed.

add.name: St. Bernard's R.C. Church
add.notes: August 1893 Sanborn, sheet 1, block 62, the Washington side. The sheet labels R.C. Church. The February 1912 sheet still labels it St. Bernard's R.C. Church, frame, veneered, with a tower. The stand-in house on this corner is taken off. The January 1886 sheets do not reach this block.
